title: Cell Culture of 7721 or HeLa Cells
author: Unknown
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.iaqcadw

steps.title: Prepare complete RPMI medium
steps.instruction: Prepare RPMI 1640 medium (Gibco, USA) supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum (Hyclone, USA) and 1% penicillin/streptomycin (Gibco, USA).

steps.title: Warm medium and trypsin
steps.instruction: Warm the complete RPMI medium to 37 °C and bring 0.1 % trypsin‑EDTA to room temperature.

steps.title: Assess cell confluency
steps.instruction: Observe the cells under a microscope to evaluate confluency and presence of cell death.

steps.title: Remove spent medium and wash
steps.instruction: When cells reach ~90 % confluency, aspirate the spent medium and wash the monolayer twice with PBS.

steps.title: Add trypsin‑EDTA and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 1 ml of 0.1 % trypsin‑EDTA to the 10‑cm culture dish, ensuring the entire surface is covered, and incubate at 37 °C for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Detach cells and neutralize
steps.instruction: Observe under the microscope until cells are fully detached, then aspirate the trypsin‑EDTA.

steps.title: Collect cells by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Add 5 ml complete medium to the dish, gently pipet to resuspend cells, transfer to a tube, and centrifuge at 1,000 rpm for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Aspirate supernatant
steps.instruction: Aspirate the supernatant carefully without disturbing the cell pellet.

steps.title: Resuspend and count cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 2 ml complete medium and determine cell number using trypan blue exclusion.

steps.title: Seed cells into 24‑well plates
steps.instruction: Seed 1 × 10⁵ cells in 500 µl per well of a 24‑well plate. Incubate at 37 °C in a humidified atmosphere (95 % humidity) with 5 % CO₂.
